usage: httpie [-h] [--debug] [--traceback] [--version] {cli} ...

Managing interface for the HTTPie itself. <https://httpie.io/docs#manager> Be
aware that you might be looking for http/https commands for sending HTTP
requests. This command is only available for managing HTTPie configuration.

positional arguments:
  {cli}

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --debug        Prints the exception traceback should one occur, as well as
                 other information useful for debugging HTTPie itself and for
                 reporting bugs.
  --traceback    Prints the exception traceback should one occur.
  --version      Show version and exit.
cli:
usage: httpie cli [-h] {export-args,check-updates,sessions} ...

Manage HTTPie for Terminal

positional arguments:
  {export-args,check-updates,sessions}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
cli export-args:
usage: httpie cli export-args [-h] [-f {json}]

Export available options for the CLI

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -f {json}, --format {json}
                        Format to export in.
cli check-updates:
usage: httpie cli check-updates [-h]

Check for updates

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
cli sessions:
usage: httpie cli sessions [-h] {upgrade,upgrade-all} ...

Manage HTTPie sessions

positional arguments:
  {upgrade,upgrade-all}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
cli sessions upgrade:
usage: httpie cli sessions upgrade [-h] [--bind-cookies]
                                   HOSTNAME SESSION_NAME_OR_PATH

Upgrade the given HTTPie session with the latest layout. A list of changes
between different session versions can be found in the official documentation.

positional arguments:
  HOSTNAME              The host this session belongs.
  SESSION_NAME_OR_PATH  The name or the path for the session that will be
                        upgraded.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --bind-cookies        Bind domainless cookies to the host that session
                        belongs.
cli sessions upgrade-all:
usage: httpie cli sessions upgrade-all [-h] [--bind-cookies]

Upgrade all named sessions with the latest layout. A list of changes between
different session versions can be found in the official documentation.

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
  --bind-cookies  Bind domainless cookies to the host that session belongs.
